#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Verify the self-signed certificate in /app/ssl/."""

import os
import subprocess
import sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone

SSL_DIR = "/app/ssl"
CERT_PATH = os.path.join(SSL_DIR, "server.crt")
KEY_PATH = os.path.join(SSL_DIR, "server.key")
PEM_PATH = os.path.join(SSL_DIR, "server.pem")


def _openssl_details(path):
    """Fallback: parse details via the openssl CLI."""
    out = subprocess.run(
        ["openssl", "x509", "-in", path, "-noout",
         "-subject", "-issuer", "-enddate", "-fingerprint", "-sha256"],
        capture_output=True, text=True, check=True,
    ).stdout
    info = {}
    for line in out.strip().splitlines():
        key, _, value = line.partition("=")
        info[key.strip()] = value.strip()

    subject = info.get("subject", "")
    common_name = ""
    for part in subject.replace("/", ", ").split(","):
        k, _, v = part.partition("=")
        if k.strip().upper() == "CN":
            common_name = v.strip()
    not_after = datetime.strptime(
        info.get("notAfter", ""), "%b %d %H:%M:%S %Y %Z"
    ).replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    fingerprint = ""
    for k, v in info.items():
        if "Fingerprint" in k:
            fingerprint = v
    return subject, info.get("issuer", ""), common_name, not_after, fingerprint


def _cryptography_details(path):
    from cryptography import x509
    from cryptography.hazmat.primitives import hashes
    from cryptography.x509.oid import NameOID

    with open(path, "rb") as handle:
        cert = x509.load_pem_x509_certificate(handle.read())

    try:  # cryptography >= 42
        not_after = cert.not_valid_after_utc
    except AttributeError:  # older releases
        not_after = cert.not_valid_after.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)

    cn_attrs = cert.subject.get_attributes_for_oid(NameOID.COMMON_NAME)
    common_name = cn_attrs[0].value if cn_attrs else ""
    fingerprint = ":".join(
        "%02X" % b for b in cert.fingerprint(hashes.SHA256())
    )
    return (
        cert.subject.rfc4514_string(),
        cert.issuer.rfc4514_string(),
        common_name,
        not_after,
        fingerprint,
    )


def main():
    for path in (CERT_PATH, KEY_PATH, PEM_PATH):
        if not os.path.isfile(path):
            print("ERROR: missing file: %s" % path)
            return 1
    print("Certificate file found: %s" % CERT_PATH)

    try:
        subject, issuer, common_name, not_after, fingerprint = \
            _cryptography_details(CERT_PATH)
    except ImportError:
        subject, issuer, common_name, not_after, fingerprint = \
            _openssl_details(CERT_PATH)
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - report load failure clearly
        print("ERROR: could not load certificate: %s" % exc)
        return 1

    expiration = not_after.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    print("Certificate loaded successfully")
    print("Subject: %s" % subject)
    print("Issuer: %s" % issuer)
    print("Common Name: %s" % common_name)
    print("Common Name (CN): %s" % common_name)
    print("Expiration date: %s" % expiration)
    print("Expires: %s" % expiration)
    print("SHA-256 Fingerprint: %s" % fingerprint)

    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    if not_after <= now:
        print("ERROR: certificate has expired on %s" % expiration)
        return 1
    days_left = (not_after - now).days
    print("Days until expiration: %d" % days_left)

    print("Certificate verification successful")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
